title: Board column template
description: The declared column collection for a Board. Azure DevOps replaces the whole collection on write, so this file plus the reconciler's preservation rules are what stand between a routine apply and lost Work Items.

preserveUndeclaredColumns.description: Must be true. A column that exists but is not declared is preserved, never deleted. The value is declared rather than assumed so that turning the guarantee off would be a visible, reviewable change - and the validator refuses it anyway.

columns.description: Ordered columns. Exactly one 'incoming' first and one 'outgoing' last; Azure DevOps rejects the entire write otherwise.

stateMappings.description: Work Item type to state. State names come from the project process, not from this repository.

previousNames.description: Names this column used to have. Transitional: it is how the reconciler recognises a renamed column and reuses its id so its Work Items follow the rename. Remove an entry once every environment has been reconciled.
